title: DynamicGenerator
description: Dynamic response model of a synchronous generator. It names five function blocks by id: a synchronous machine model, a shaft, an excitation system, a turbine governor, and a power system stabilizer. It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of the generator's data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

omega_ref.description: Frequency reference set-point, in natural units. Usually equal to the system frequency. Units: Hz.

synchronous_machine_dynamics.description: ID of the SynchronousMachineDynamics function block: the machine model for the electromagnetic dynamics.

shaft.description: ID of the Shaft function block: the shaft model for the electromechanical dynamics.

excitation_system_dynamics.description: ID of the ExcitationSystemDynamics function block: the excitation system model.

turbine_governor_dynamics.description: ID of the TurbineGovernorDynamics function block: the prime mover and turbine governor model.

power_system_stabilizer_dynamics.description: ID of the PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics function block: the power system stabilizer model.

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of the referenced function blocks. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.
